Lido finance is a liquid staking protocol on public blockchains that lets users stake assets without running their own validator. Lido finance issues stETH as a token representing staked ether. Lido finance is governed by holders of its LDO governance token.

Cap Finance is a DeFi protocol built on smart contracts. Cap Finance issues the cUSD stablecoin.

Pendle is a yield trading protocol built on smart contracts on public blockchains. Pendle splits yield-bearing assets into principal tokens and yield tokens. Pendle enables users to trade future yield before maturity.

Oraclize is a blockchain oracle service that supplies external data to smart contracts. Oraclize was later renamed Provable. Oraclize is a service provider rather than a DeFi application itself.

Level Finance is a DeFi protocol operating on the BNB Chain. Level Finance offers perpetual trading services through smart contracts. Level Finance uses the LVL token within its ecosystem.
